### Change description

### Testing done

### Human verification and limitations

### Breaking and operational impact

### Security vulnerability assessment

### Checklist

- [ ] Acceptance Criteria are mapped to implementation and evidence.
- [ ] Stack base and dependencies are accurate, or the change is independent.
- [ ] Commits follow repository conventions.
- [ ] Documentation and tests are updated where needed.
- [ ] Exact verification evidence and skipped-check reasons are included.
- [ ] Human-only verification, assumptions, and limitations are disclosed.
- [ ] Agent review is complete and blocking findings are resolved.
- [ ] Security and sensitive-data handling were assessed.
- [ ] API, migration, configuration, deployment, and operational impact is stated.
